name: Kakitsubata Gorou
source: Very refined, polite and mild-mannered, Gorou is a traditionalist gentleman. He has known Akane's parents for a while; tasked with managing the floral displays of the restaurant. Gorou seems to especially get along with Miyoko. He's very calm and relaxed, and seems to calm those around him as well. Gorou sometimes makes some unexpected observations or statements, which makes Akane occasionally describe him as a "strange man". When he's not busy taking care of the restaurant's flowers, he works as a Kadou (flower arrangement art) teacher.
